gloss: one or the other; either; whichever

definitions.gloss: one or the other; either; whichever
definitions.explanation: A formal pronoun used to select one item from a set of options, meaning 'one of' or 'either one.' More literary than どれか or どちらか, and commonly found in written documents and official instructions.

examples.japanese: いずれか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}べ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
いずれか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んで→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please apply using one of the methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いずれか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to meet one or the other of the conditions for this problem.

notes:
A formal pronoun meaning "one of" or "either one" from a set of options. More literary and formal than ⟦どれか→どれか：22606_doreka⟧ or ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧. Often used in written documents, contracts, and official instructions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- いずれか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: one of the ~
- いずれか⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose one or the other
- いずれか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}する→該当する：29179_gaitousuru⟧: to fall under one of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どれか→どれか：22606_doreka⟧ — which one (casual, general)
- ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧ — one of two (polite but less formal than いずれか)
- ⟦いずれも→いずれも：16830_izuremo⟧ — all of them; every one (contrasts with いずれか which selects one)
